title: Add CoarseReminderWorker
description: WorkManager CoroutineWorker used as the fallback reminder path when exact-alarm scheduling isn't permitted. Mirrors ReminderAlarmReceiver.onReceive() -- reads the same three extras and calls NotificationHelper.sendReminder directly.
acceptance_criteria: class CoarseReminderWorker(context: Context, params: WorkerParameters) : CoroutineWorker(context, params)
doWork() reads doseLogId via inputData.getInt(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_DOSE_LOG_ID, -1), returning Result.failure() if it's -1
doWork() reads title and text via inputData.getString(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_TITLE) / EXTRA_TEXT, returning Result.failure() if either is null
On success, calls NotificationHelper.sendReminder(applicationContext, doseLogId, title, text) and returns Result.success()
